parse_units.content: Adaptive Metric Compiler
Theoretical framework for recursive metric discovery and intelligence as adaptive metric compilation.
Most optimization frameworks assume an objective, representation or metric; AMP focuses on discovery of better metrics.
A bounded agent recursively transforms meaningful environmental differences into increasingly informative internal metrics.
Improved mapping quality expands computationally viable solutions and enables further metric discovery.
Delta --[chi,B,F]--> M_Q --[Q_M,D_Omega]--> M_Q', with an asymptotic viable-space expression.
Source interprets the kernel as a complete proposed cycle from perception to recursive representational improvement.
Causal Mass weights differences using informational rarity and influence on future action.
Salience converts causal significance into computational priority.
Selected information is transformed into an adaptive internal metric.
Mapping quality is multidimensional and assesses computational usefulness.
Discovery searches over mappings rather than optimizing only within one.
Each discovered metric expands viable computation and enables additional discoveries.
Intelligence is the recursive execution of metric discovery.
Optimization improves solutions within M_Q; discovery changes M_Q to M_Q'.
README depicts examples/ and simulations/ directories among repository components.
Early-stage theoretical framework.
Definitions are presented as a foundation for future math, validation, experiments and comparison; source calls AMP a research program rather than completed theory.
Defines primary mathematical objects and symbols for AMP.
Not all observable differences are computationally meaningful.

parse_units.content: Higher Phi means stronger causal influence; M_C combines rarity and behavioral influence and is used to prioritize differences.

parse_units.content: Gate represents limited computational resources.

content.Q_M: quality of metric for future computation

Presents historical/computational transitions that can be interpreted through AMP; does not present them as executed AMP experiments.
Early additive numeral systems required explicit manipulation of many symbols and scaled poorly with magnitude.
Positional notation made symbol position meaningful and compactly represented large quantities.
AMP interprets positional notation as D_Omega producing search compression, easier arithmetic and scalable computation.
Earlier geometric reasoning is described as direct object relations requiring specialized reasoning.
Cartesian coordinates map space into numeric coordinates, making geometry algebraically accessible.
AMP interprets coordinates as preserving invariants while expanding viable computation.
Static descriptions made continuous change difficult to formalize.
Calculus introduced derivative and integral representations for change and accumulation.
AMP interprets calculus as a computational language making dynamic systems tractable.
Before autodiff, gradients are described as requiring manual symbolic derivation.
Autodiff is described as transforming programs into derivative computations.
AMP interprets autodiff as reducing metric-construction cost and enabling faster optimization/experimentation.
Direct machine-instruction programming required human reasoning close to hardware.
Compilers map high-level languages to machine execution and expose abstractions.
AMP interprets compilers as metrics separating problem specification from execution mechanism and expanding viable computation.
Minimax search is described as exploring exponentially growing game trees directly.
Alpha-beta pruning is described as eliminating irrelevant branches from effective search.
AMP interprets pruning as reducing computational geometry rather than increasing raw compute.
Traditional ML is described as relying heavily on engineered features.
Deep neural networks are described as introducing hierarchical learned representations.
AMP interpretation states that the metric became adaptive and learned representations exposed useful structure before the source breaks off.
